findings.text: This commit marks the task DONE on the strength of the Nix gates "at stack head 761208cf244b", but that commit is the parent of 93ea469afea8, before the task file (4e4c1b7fa986) and every commit that adds the copy laws, so those gates cannot contain "the rebuild proofs and the pinned SQLite replays" or show the "Nix gates on the completed stack" that the task's acceptance needs. Fix: Give the revision that the gates actually ran on, which must include 06c80c0e7fd3, or run `just test-nix` on the completed stack and cite that run before you mark the task DONE.

The text says the pinned SQLite regressions distinguish the ordinary row operation from "indexed rowid transfer", but `tests/surface/Schema/Tests/RebuildReplays.lean` replays only `copy-audit`, `copy-foreign-key` and `copy-implicit`; `copy-implicit` has no index, and no pinned replay runs the indexed transfer from line 46. Fix: Remove "indexed rowid transfer" from that sentence, or add a pinned replay of the indexed transfer and cite it.
